reasoning: 20.7（FF6）規定 shuffle 開啟時只影響目前資料夾，除非選了 All Songs，此時該資料夾的歌曲與子資料夾內容一併 shuffle。037 拆成兩個 leaf，兩者是 All Songs 是否被選取的等價配對（§7），各自成一筆。shuffle 的驗證不能要求特定順序（隨機），故 ER 以「播放範圍」判定而非順序——092-01 驗連續播放數首後仍全部落在該資料夾內、092-02 驗會出現子資料夾的歌曲，這是 shuffle 情境下唯一可判定的形式，且正好對應本條真正規範的內容（範圍而非順序）。條文末的 ** This will apply to USB Folders and Disc 指同一規則適用於光碟，但 037 未配光碟的 leaf，本批依 leaf 範圍以 USB 驗證，缺口記於 ANOMALIES A-008 的同一模式。§8.5：catalog 建立狀態由 BT1.9／COM-070~073 擁有，不寫進 Pre-Condition。優先級：shuffle 範圍錯誤會播出非預期內容，兩筆皆 P1。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 092-01 為未選 All Songs 時 shuffle 只在本資料夾，092-02 為選了 All Songs 時含子資料夾

tcs.test_item:
The system shall apply shuffle only to the current USB folder when shuffle is enabled and 'All Songs' is not selected.

(Shuffle scope without All Songs)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive is connected to the HU with this structure: the root holds two folders and two songs; each folder holds two subfolders and, in one case, two songs of its own; each subfolder holds two songs
2. USB is the active source on the HU
3. One of the root folders holds two songs of its own in addition to its subfolders
4. Shuffle is enabled on the HU
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the Folders category in the Categories Bank
4. Press the folder that holds songs of its own and record its own songs and the songs held in its subfolders
5. Press one of the folder's own songs to start playback and read the song shown as playing
6. Press the seek next control repeatedly and read the song shown as playing after each press
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and USB is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The folder browse list is displayed in the Browse List
4. The folder's own songs and the songs held in its subfolders are recorded
5. A song held directly in that folder is shown as playing
6. Every song shown as playing is one of the folder's own songs recorded in step 4, and no song from its subfolders is played

tcs.test_item:
The system shall apply shuffle to the songs in the current USB folder and its subfolders when shuffle is enabled and 'All Songs' is selected.

(Shuffle scope with All Songs selected)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive is connected to the HU with this structure: the root holds two folders and two songs; each folder holds two subfolders and, in one case, two songs of its own; each subfolder holds two songs
2. USB is the active source on the HU
3. One of the root folders holds two songs of its own in addition to its subfolders
4. Shuffle is enabled on the HU
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the Folders category in the Categories Bank
4. Press the folder that holds songs of its own and record its own songs and the songs held in its subfolders
5. Press "All Songs", press one of the songs listed to start playback and read the song shown as playing
6. Press the seek next control repeatedly and read the song shown as playing after each press
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and USB is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The folder browse list is displayed in the Browse List
4. The folder's own songs and the songs held in its subfolders are recorded
5. One of the songs recorded in step 4 is shown as playing
6. Songs held in the subfolders are among the songs played, so the shuffle scope covers the folder and its subfolders together
